title: Negation
summary: Negation forms a statement that denies another statement under the chosen semantics.

content.plain: Negation forms a statement that denies another statement under the chosen semantics.
content.exact: ¬ is a unary connective. In classical two-valued semantics, v(¬P)=1 exactly when v(P)=0; constructive semantics gives a different proof-theoretic reading.
content.caveat: Double-negation elimination is not valid in every logic.
